Manage named VM saved-state snapshots.

```text
pomme snapshot SUBCOMMAND
```

## pomme snapshot create

Create a named saved-state snapshot.

```text
pomme snapshot create [VM] --snapshot NAME [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `VM` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--snapshot NAME` | Snapshot name. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme snapshot list

List saved-state snapshots for a VM.

```text
pomme snapshot list [VM] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `VM` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme snapshot restore

Restore a named saved-state snapshot.

```text
pomme snapshot restore [VM] --snapshot NAME [--force] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `VM` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--snapshot NAME` | Snapshot name. |
| `-f`, `--force` | Restore without prompting and accept recorded drift; old machine state may expose inconsistent guest filesystems. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme snapshot delete

Delete a named saved-state snapshot.

```text
pomme snapshot delete [VM] --snapshot NAME [--force] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `VM` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--snapshot NAME` | Snapshot name. |
| `-f`, `--force` | Delete without prompting. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
